categories.name: animal
categories.gloss: A living organism that feeds on organic matter.

categories.name: mammal
categories.gloss: A warm-blooded vertebrate that nurses its young.

categories.name: bird
categories.gloss: A warm-blooded egg-laying vertebrate with feathers.

categories.name: feline
categories.gloss: A member of the cat family.

categories.name: canine
categories.gloss: A member of the dog family.

categories.name: cetacean
categories.gloss: An aquatic mammal of the whale order.

categories.name: seabird
categories.gloss: A bird that lives mainly on or near the sea.

entities.name: tiger
entities.definition: A large striped Asian cat.

entities.name: lion
entities.definition: A large African cat that lives in prides.

entities.name: leopard
entities.definition: A spotted big cat of Africa and Asia.

entities.name: jaguar
entities.definition: A powerful spotted cat of the Americas.

entities.name: cheetah
entities.definition: The fastest running land animal.

entities.name: lynx
entities.definition: A medium-sized wild cat with tufted ears.

entities.name: wolf
entities.definition: A large wild member of the dog family.

entities.name: coyote
entities.definition: A small wolflike canine of North America.

entities.name: jackal
entities.definition: A small wild dog of Africa and Asia.

entities.name: dingo
entities.definition: A wild dog of Australia.

entities.name: fox
entities.definition: A small canine with a bushy tail.

entities.name: dolphin
entities.definition: A small toothed whale known for intelligence.

entities.name: porpoise
entities.definition: A small cetacean with a blunt snout.

entities.name: narwhal
entities.definition: An Arctic whale with a long spiral tusk.

entities.name: orca
entities.definition: A large black and white toothed whale.

entities.name: eagle
entities.definition: A large bird of prey with keen eyesight.

entities.name: falcon
entities.definition: A fast-flying bird of prey.

entities.name: hawk
entities.definition: A broad-winged bird of prey.

entities.name: osprey
entities.definition: A fish-eating bird of prey.

entities.name: albatross
entities.definition: A very large seabird with long narrow wings.

entities.name: puffin
entities.definition: A small seabird with a brightly coloured bill.

entities.name: gannet
entities.definition: A large seabird that dives for fish.

entities.name: petrel
entities.definition: A seabird that flies far from land.
